purpose: Compare explicit medium versus max reasoning effort on the four strongest whole conversations from winning prompt-factorial cell C while changing no prompt, character, scenario, turn, history, reflection, or orchestration variable.

selection.population: The eight completed conversations in cell C: one-time second-person identity, current CharacterAgent instructions, and no private reflection.
rule: Sort descending by finalized whole-conversation consensus status scored pass=2, mixed=1, fail=0.
Then sort descending by the sum of the two original reviewers' whole-conversation statuses on the same 0-2 scale.
Then sort descending by the sum of all 24 original reviewer dimension ratings on the same 0-2 scale.
Break any remaining tie by ascending blind_id. Select the first four.
selection.limitation: Selecting prior top performers makes this a ceiling and robustness test. It is not an unbiased estimate of reasoning effort over the full scenario distribution.

frozen_controls.identity_delivery: once per rendered identity revision and retained in actor-private history

parallel_launch.dependency_boundary: The eight conversations are independent and launch together. Within each conversation, turns remain sequential because each actor must receive the other actor's preceding observable response.

inspection_contract.during_generation: Technical telemetry only; do not read or judge dialogue prose.

review_contract.blinding: Assemble all eight completed conversations into one shuffled packet with reasoning condition and prior rank hidden.
review_contract.reviewers: Two independent max-reasoning Sol reviewers apply the existing whole-conversation dramatic-dialogue rubric.
review_contract.adjudication: A third max-reasoning Sol adjudicates only overall-status disagreements after both reviews are locked.
review_contract.primary_comparison: Matched per-case finalized whole-conversation status, scored pass=2, mixed=1, fail=0; report max wins, ties, losses, and mean paired score difference relative to medium.
review_contract.secondary_comparison: Original-reviewer dimension score differences, technical validity, latency, retries, and reasoning-token telemetry when available.
review_contract.interpretation: Do not infer that max is generally better or worse from four selected cases; treat any result as evidence about ceiling-case robustness requiring broader replication.
